Field
Description
DataEgressId
Value that uniquely identifies an egress event among all other egress events. A unique identifier is required for every
egress event to ensure that an event doesn’t persist and process twice.
ComputerName
Name of the device on which sensor is running.
UserSid
The User Security Identifier (UserSID) of the user who executed the command. A UserSID uniquely identifies a user in a
system.
Values:
SELF_RID (0x01010000000000050A000000)
UserName
Operating system username.
FileIdentifier
File identified on the Windows system that is used to match with the ArchiveFileContent event to show archive content in
User Activities.
AssessedFileName
Absolute path of file that is a target of File Assessment Manager actor.
ContentSHA256HashData
The SHA256 hash of an egressing file.
Size
Size of the egressing file in bytes.
ContextTimeStamp
System time of event creation.
ContextProcessId
UPID of process originating this event.
PolicyIdentifier
ID of Data Protection Policy matched to the egress event.
PolicyName
Name of of Data Protection Policy matched to the egress event.
AppliedClassificationEntityId
ID of the classification that owns the executed Data Protection rule. Populated if the rule of one of the matched
classifications is executed.
AppliedClassificationName
Name of the classification that owns executed Data Protection rule. Populated if the rule of one of the matched
classifications is executed.
DataEgressRuleId
ID of the Data Protection EgressRulePopulated if Data Protection EgressRule applied.
DataProtectionPolicyRuleAction
Action taken in response to data protection policy.  Values are as follows: NOT_COVERED (0) - there are no protection
policy rules assigned to any classification of egressing file. BLOCKED (1) - protection policy rules assigned to one of
classifications of egressing file denied this egress. ALLOWED (2) - protection policy rules assigned to one of
classifications of egressing file allowed this egress. BLOCKED_SIMULATION (3) - protection policy rules assigned to one
of classifications of egressing file would have denied this egress if enforced. ALLOWED_SIMULATION (4) - protection
policy rules assigned to one of classifications of egressing file would have allowed this egress if enforced.
Values:
NOT_COVERED (0)
BLOCKED (1)
ALLOWED (2)
BLOCKED_SIMULATION (3)
ALLOWED_SIMULATION (4)
JUSTIFIED_SIMULATION (5)
DataProtectionTestMode
In test mode, the sensor might mark the Policy Rule Action as BLOCKED in the cloud, but won’t block it for the user. Test
mode allows you to add protection policy rules and monitor their results for some time without fear of blocking legitimate
data movement.
DataProtectionUserNotified
Will be true if the user received visual warning notification from sensor during attempt of the egress.
DataOriginsDerived
Is true if the data egress is similar to other sensitive data observed by the sensor. Example: User downloads two files:
fileA from Box and fileB from GoogleDrive. User copies the content of fileA and fileB into fileC. User downloads fileA, fileB,
and fileC to a USB.Cloud receives 3 EgressEvents; one for each file.Egress event for fileC should have Derived = true,
because fileC is derived from fileA and fileB. (It will have Box and Google Drive as the origin web locations.) Egress events
for fileA and fileB should have Derived = false.
DataProtectionProperties
Data properties describe data from various dimensions, including origin, content patterns, labels, and so on.

Field
Description
DataEgressDestination
Destination of the dataDescribes the channel of egress and a specific set of metadata, depending on the egress channel
value.
RuleActionEnforcementStatus
Populates when a rule fails to enforce a block egress action. This is a very low probability error.
Values:
STATUS_UNSUCCESSFUL (0xC0000001)
DataAssessmentStatus
Populates when an unsupported file type is egressed.
Values:
STATUS_FILE_NOT_SUPPORTED (0xC00004B4)
DataProtectionSimilarFiles
DataProtectionEventAttributes
A bit field describing additional data protection event attributes.
Values:
CLIPBOARD (0x0001)
INTRUSIVE_SCAN_SKIPPED (0x0002)
JUSTIFICATION_SKIPPED_SYSTEM_TRAY_DISABLED (0x0004)
JUSTIFICATION_SKIPPED_BATCH_BLOCKED (0x0008)
JUSTIFICATION_SKIPPED_SESSION_0 (0x0010)
NETWORK_INSPECTION_EGRESS (0x0020)
AssessmentEventId
Unique identifier for cloudable events generated by data protection assessment to correlate with DataEgress events.
DataProtectionDetectionMarker
Would be set to true when an egress matches the rule with detections enabled. Not used in simulation mode.
DataProtectionDetectionSeverity
Severity set on the matched rule.
Values:
0 - informational
1 - low
2 - medium
3- high
4-critical
NormalizedPath
A field containing a normalized version of a file path.
ForensicsEnableTimestamp
The time data forensics feature was enabled at policy.
ForensicsEnablerUserId
The user that has enabled/disabled data forensics feature at policy.
ForensicsPolicyStatus
The status of policy's data forensics at the time of egress.
Values:
DISABLED (0)
ENABLED (1)
ENABLED_STORED (2)
ForensicsClassificationStatus
The status of data forensics settings for the applied classification.
Values:
DISABLED (0)
ENABLED (1)
JustificationUserAction
Action taken by user to justify data egress.
Values:
JUSTIFIED (0)
CANCELLED (1)
TIMED_OUT (2)
JustificationReason
Justification reason configured by customer Data Protection Policy. For example: Business purposes or Personal use.
JustificationUserExplanation
Explanation provided by user in addition to JustificationReason.
DataEncryptionEventId
Unique identifier for cloudable DataEncryption events generated by data protection actor to correlate with DataEgress
events.
EncryptedFilesForensicsPolicyStatus
The status of store-encrypted-files-evidence policy at the time of egress.
Values:
DISABLED (0)
ENABLED (1)
EgressBatchID
EgressBatchID indicates which batch a DataEgress event was part of. DataEgress events can have outcomes determined
as a batch.
